sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops Madme, which shows ads over other apps, after calls, when you unlock the phone, and as notifications.
Stops Tealium, Swrve, and Firebase Analytics. Marketing notifications and in-app promotions from Swrve stop too. Sign-in, activation, and the support chat are left alone. Opt-in; test on-device.
Stops Quantum Metric, which records what you do in the app, your network calls, and your phone number.

Gives the app a random per-install Android ID instead of your device's, and reports a zeroed advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you had deleted your ad ID in Android settings. The video DRM ID is left alone so playback works. O…
